notes: relevant_docs is the retrieval ground truth: the documents that actually contain the answer.
must_contain lets scripts/validate_goldset.py prove each annotation against the corpus text, so the labels are checkable rather than asserted.
answerable=false entries have no supporting document anywhere in the corpus. Correct behaviour is refusal, not an answer; they measure abstention.

judgment_0004/0006, judgment_0072/0078 and judgment_0122/0125 are duplicate case pairs present in input/ -- the same judgment from two reporters. Both copies are listed as relevant where applicable, because both are legitimately correct retrievals.

difficulty=hard questions are deliberately phrased in lay terms that share little vocabulary with the judgment, so lexical and semantic retrieval can be told apart. The standard tier is near-saturated and cannot.
